author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Cleverbridge confirms attackers stole payment card numbers, expiry dates and CVV codes, warning customers to watch for fraudulent transactions. Cleverbridge, which runs checkouts, payments and subscriptions for other companies, has confirmed that attackers copied payment card data from its platform. The company says it found the problem on 4 November and started notifying affected people […]
title: Cleverbridge Confirms Attackers Copied Payment Card Data From Its Platform

author: Pierluigi Paganini

title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health Breach Exposes Tenant Metadata and Admin Details

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Bulgaria uncovered a five-year cyberespionage campaign that stole 130GB of government files. The attacker and full impact remain unknown. Bulgaria ‘s ministry for innovation and digital transformation announced it had uncovered a hacking operation running since 2021. Reuters reports that more than 130 GB of documents, about 62 million pages, were downloaded from government databases […]
title: Bulgaria Discovers Massive Government Breach After Five Years of Undetected Spying

author: Pierluigi Paganini

title: BADBOX 3.0 Exposed: Massive Botnet Hides Ad Fraud Inside Android TV Boxes
